details.question: 广东、浙江、四川三省的销售额对比
details.sql:
SELECT dim_region.province, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS total_sales
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_region ON fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id
WHERE dim_region.province IN ('广东省', '浙江省', '四川省')
GROUP BY dim_region.province
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

details.question: 手机数码和家用电器两个品类的销售情况对比
details.sql:
SELECT dim_product.category, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS total_sales, SUM(fact_order.order_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_product ON fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id
WHERE dim_product.category IN ('手机数码', '家用电器')
GROUP BY dim_product.category
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
